name: FFS_RESOURCE_CALENDAR
description: Contains calendar records configured on the resource level.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the record.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a resource.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Type of resource calendar record. Available values: 'schedule', 'shift', 'extra_shift', 'working', 'extra_working', 'non-working'.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date since when this record is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date until which this record is active. If empty - the calendar record is considered as infinite.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to a parent record which represents a work schedule (with RECORD_TYPE = 'schedule'). This field is only assigned if this record is added as a part of the schedule (RECORD_TYPE='schedule').

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a work schedule. This field is assigned only if RECORD_TYPE = 'schedule'.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a work schedule item. This field is assigned only if this record is added as a part of the schedule (RECORD_TYPE = 'schedule' and PARENT_ID is non empty).

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a work shift. This field is assigned only if RECORD_TYPE = 'shift'.

columns.name: SHIFT_TYPE
columns.description: Work shift type. Available values: 'regular', 'on-call'. This field is assigned only if RECORD_TYPE in 'working', 'extra_working' or 'non-working'.

columns.name: NON_WORKING_REASON_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a lookup (with FFS_LOOKUP.LOOKUP_TYPE = 7) representing a non working reason. This field is only assigned if RECORD_TYPE = 'non-working'.

columns.name: TIME_FROM
columns.description: Indicates time since when the record is active. Represented in minutes since midnight in resource's time zone. This field is assigned only if RECORD_TYPE in 'Working' or 'Extra_Working'.

columns.name: TIME_TO
columns.description: Indicates time until which the record is active. Represented in minutes since midnight in resource's time zone. This field is assigned only if RECORD_TYPE in 'Working' or 'Extra_Working'.

columns.name: POINTS
columns.description: It is a number of available points for this shift. This field is assigned only if RECORD_TYPE in 'working' or 'extra_working'.

columns.name: RECURRENCE
columns.description: Calendar recurrence type. Available values: 'none', 'daily', 'weekly', 'yearly'.

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: Bit mask which defines the days of week to be selected. This field is assigned only if RECURRENCE = 'weekly'. Values: 1 - Sun, 2 - Mon, 4 - Tue, 8 - Wed, 16 - Thu, 32 - Fri, 64 - Sun.

columns.name: RECUR_EVERY
columns.description: Defines number of days (if RECURRENCE = Daily) or weeks (if RECURRENCE = weekly) to skip. This field is assigned only if RECURRENCE in 'daily' or 'weekly'.

columns.name: FROM_DAY
columns.description: Indicates date since when the period is active. This field is assigned only if RECURRENCE = 'yearly'.

columns.name: TO_DAY
columns.description: Indicates date until which the period is active. This field is assigned only if RECURRENCE = 'yearly'.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Contains meaningfull text description of the calendar record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
